title: Desk Note on Reinstatement, Term Extension and Payment Pause Allowances by Plan — Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements
content:
# Desk note — reinstatement, extension and pause allowances under Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements

Whether a delinquent agreement may be brought current, whether the term may be extended and whether payments may be paused, and at what charge or for how long, are settled plan by plan. The figures for each plan of Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements are these.

| Plan | Reinstatement admitted | Reinstatement fee (USD) | Term extension admitted | Days an extension adds | Extension fee (USD) | Payment pause admitted | Longest pause (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30-Day Hold Agreement | no | 0.00 | no | 0 | 0.00 | no | 0 |
| 90-Day Layaway | yes | 20.00 | yes | 30 | 25.00 | no | 0 |
| 6-Month Layaway | yes | 25.00 | yes | 60 | 35.00 | yes | 30 |
| 12-Month Bridal Layaway | yes | 35.00 | yes | 90 | 50.00 | yes | 60 |
| Special Order Layaway | yes | 30.00 | no | 0 | 0.00 | no | 0 |
| Gift Registry Layaway | yes | 25.00 | yes | 60 | 35.00 | yes | 45 |

## Plan by plan

- **30-Day Hold Agreement**: no reinstatement, no extension, no pause.
- **90-Day Layaway**: reinstatement at 20.00; one extension of 30 days at 25.00; no pause.
- **6-Month Layaway**: reinstatement at 25.00; one extension of 60 days at 35.00; a pause of up to 30 days.
- **12-Month Bridal Layaway**: reinstatement at 35.00; one extension of 90 days at 50.00; a pause of up to 60 days.
- **Special Order Layaway**: reinstatement at 30.00; no extension; no pause.
- **Gift Registry Layaway**: reinstatement at 25.00; one extension of 60 days at 35.00; a pause of up to 45 days.

## Points of judgement

- Reinstatement admitted means a delinquent agreement on that plan may be brought current rather than forfeited; the reinstatement fee is what that costs.
- Term extension admitted means the term may be extended once, by the days shown, for the fee shown.
- Payment pause admitted means payments may be paused for a spell no longer than the days shown.
